title: IDEMIA Secure Transactions and IonQ Validate QKD Interoperability with IDEMIA Sphere Cybersecurity Platform - Quantum Computing Report
author: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
text:
IDEMIA Secure Transactions (IST) and IonQ (NYSE: IONQ) have validated interoperability between IonQ’s Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) systems and IST’s IDEMIA Sphere cybersecurity portfolio. The demonstration shows how quantum-generated cryptographic keys can be ingested, governed, and managed alongside Hardware Security Modules (HSMs) and Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) within existing enterprise security controls and compliance workflows.

Designed for critical infrastructure operators across financial services, telecommunications, and government networks, the integrated architecture combines HSM-protected key lifecycle management, PQC algorithms, and physical QKD links to support defense-in-depth quantum-safe communications without requiring organizations to replace established security governance frameworks.
